description: The Aarequai is the riverside quay in Thun, a lamp-lit walk along the Aare between the town houses. The four-tower keep already published stays out of the frame, and so does Schloss Schadau on the lake. This is not Hilterfingen and not Oberhofen. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 13°C, with little wind, humid air, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
